faq.label: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.title: Common Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to the most frequently asked questions about our recycling services.

questions.q1: How does the recycling process work?
questions.a1: We collect plastic, sort by type, wash, shred and transform it into raw material for new products.
questions.q2: What types of plastic do you accept?
questions.a2: We accept PET, HDPE, PVC, LDPE, PP, PS and other common thermoplastics.
questions.a3: Use our online form or call directly. We offer door-to-door collection.
questions.q4: How much does the service cost?
questions.a4: For individuals, the service is free. For companies, we offer competitive prices.
questions.q5: How can I help beyond recycling?
questions.a5: Educate others about recycling, participate in our awareness campaigns and donate to environmental projects.
